title: Simple Todo App
originalPrompt: Build a todo app where I can sign in, add tasks, and mark them done.

components.name: Todo List Page
components.purpose: Displays the user's todo items and lets them mark items complete.

components.name: Login Page
components.purpose: Collects email and password and starts a session.

components.name: Todo API
components.purpose: CRUD endpoints for todo items, scoped to the authenticated user.

components.name: Auth Service
components.purpose: Issues and verifies session tokens on login.

components.name: todos table
components.purpose: Stores todo items with owner_id, text, and completed flag.

components.name: users table
components.purpose: Stores user email and hashed password.

components.name: Session Middleware
components.purpose: Rejects API requests without a valid session token.

constraints.rawText: The frontend must never talk to the database directly.
